status_key.done: Finished. Usually already reflected in prices, so no forecast uplift.
status_key.building: Under construction with committed funding. Small forecast uplift.
status_key.planning: Funded for planning or design only. No construction commitment. Tiny uplift.
status_key.proposed: Advocacy or land reserved, no funding. No uplift; watch it.
status_key.risk: Stalled or shrinking. Shown as a caution, no uplift.

projects.name: Metro Tunnel
projects.what: Sunbury line trains now run through new CBD tunnel stations, adding capacity and cutting transfers.

projects.name: Airport Rail Stage 1 – Sunshine rebuild
projects.what: Rebuilds the Sunshine corridor (West Footscray to Albion), which Sunbury, Melton and Wyndham Vale area trains pass through. A Keilor East station is due in 2031. No date has been set for the airport section.

projects.name: New Melton Hospital (Cobblebank)
projects.what: Full public hospital run by Western Health, expected to treat about 130,000 patients a year. A major local employer.

projects.name: Melton line electrification
projects.when: Planning 2026 to mid-2027; no build date
projects.what: Design, environmental assessment and approvals to turn the diesel V/Line service into metro trains. If construction is funded, this would be the biggest upgrade Melton could get.

projects.name: Wyndham Vale line – longer trains
projects.what: More capacity on the Regional Rail Link services through Tarneit and Wyndham Vale. Electrification is in a later stage of the Western Rail Plan with no funding.

projects.name: East Werribee Employment Precinct
projects.when: Structure plan under review; no build commitment
projects.what: Melbourne's largest undeveloped block of state government land, with targets of 50,000–58,000 jobs over time. It is Wyndham Council's top advocacy priority, but progress has been slow for a decade.

projects.name: Beveridge Intermodal Precinct (Inland Rail terminal)
projects.what: Melbourne's first terminal for 1.8 km double-stacked Inland Rail freight trains, handling 200,000–500,000 containers a year. Brings logistics jobs, and also heavier truck traffic on the Hume.

projects.name: Western Interstate Freight Terminal (Truganina)
projects.when: Land being protected; no build date
projects.what: Future second interstate freight terminal in the west, to be built when capacity is needed. A long-term jobs anchor if it proceeds.

projects.name: Armadale line rebuild + Byford extension
projects.what: Level crossings removed, new elevated stations, and the line extended 8 km to Byford. Part of why the corridor ran so hard in 2024–26.

projects.name: Thornlie–Cockburn Link
projects.what: First east–west cross-suburban rail link, joining the Armadale and Mandurah lines.

projects.name: Byford Health Hub
projects.what: Urgent-care hub to take pressure off Armadale Hospital's emergency department, which sees 70,000+ presentations a year.

projects.name: Karnup METRONET station
projects.what: New Mandurah line station south of Baldivis and Port Kennedy. Shortens the trip to rail for the southern Rockingham suburbs.

projects.name: Henderson Defence Precinct (AUKUS)
projects.when: Site chosen Aug 2026; submarine rotations from 2027
projects.what: Naval shipbuilding and nuclear-submarine maintenance hub, with about 10,000 direct jobs over 20 years. The single biggest jobs driver near the Kwinana suburbs.

projects.name: Westport – Kwinana outer harbour
projects.when: Marine EOIs Jul 2026; construction ~2028; full port late 2030s
projects.what: Perth's new container port, replacing Fremantle. Long-dated. The opposition says it has been pushed back; the government says it's on track. Brings jobs, freight traffic and noise.

projects.name: Rockingham General Hospital works
projects.when: Mental health centre under construction; $1m master plan Aug 2026
projects.what: New mental health emergency centre and behavioural assessment unit now. A 20-year master plan for expansion is being prepared.

projects.name: Kwinana lithium refineries
projects.what: Two of three local refineries are stalled or idled. Wesfarmers–SQM's Covalent plant is ramping up below target. A weaker jobs story than 2022–23 promised.
